India's Public Sector Undertakings Expand Solar Power Capacity

Two major Indian public sector undertakings, NTPC and Coal India, have operationalized or secured significant solar power projects. NTPC has commissioned a 176-megawatt solar project in Telangana, while Coal India has won a bid for a 600-megawatt solar project in Uttar Pradesh valued at over ₹2,800 crore. These developments signal a continued push towards increasing green energy generation capacity across the country.
